## 2026-04-23 - XML External Entity (XXE) Vulnerability in Test Parsing
**Vulnerability:** The `swarm/runtime/test_parser.py` module used the standard library `xml.etree.ElementTree` to parse JUnit XML files. This is vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) injection if an attacker can control the input XML.
**Learning:** XML parsers in Python's standard library are vulnerable to XXE by default. When parsing external or untrusted XML (like test results generated by potentially compromised test runners), a secure parser like `defusedxml` must be used.
**Prevention:** Always use `defusedxml.ElementTree` instead of `xml.etree.ElementTree` for parsing XML data, especially when the source of the XML is untrusted or external.
